claim_scope: resource-bounded verified-success superiority of a fixed GoW implementation over a matched adaptive-search comparator, on a declared task population with executable verification
note: This is a PREREGISTRATION. No runs have been executed. It fixes the design so that a later confirmatory run cannot silently change endpoints, budgets, comparator, or analysis. It is the empirical premise for the conditional theorem in paper section 9 (Conditional Superiority); it does not itself establish any advantage.

primary_claim.outcome: Y_pi(B) = 1 iff method pi achieves the verified objective within total budget B, else 0
primary_claim.confirmatory_test: Delta(B) > delta for a declared practical margin delta
primary_claim.primary_statistic: paired difference D_i = Y_{G,i} - Y_{C,i} in {-1,0,1}; Delta_hat = mean(D_i)
primary_claim.primary_certificate: one-sided Hoeffding lower bound L_alpha = Delta_hat - sqrt(2 log(1/alpha) / n); success iff L_alpha > delta
primary_claim.secondary_null_test: exact paired-discordance (McNemar) test on discordant pairs against equal-success null
primary_claim.secondary_efficiency_measure: E[min(T_pi, B)] with T_pi = infinity on failure (budget-capped time/cost to verified success)

arms.description: Same model, raw history, tools, checker, and total budget. Ordinary candidate generation, feedback, reflection, and revision. NOT prohibited from noticing interactions, drawing analogies, or reasoning about failures.
Explicit representation selection, shape hypotheses, adversarial challenge, structural-intervention selection, projection into domain candidates, and feedback-driven update.
Comparable organization/retrieval assistance WITHOUT the explicit shape-to-action policy. Isolates whether any gain comes from search control rather than convenient history presentation.

population.domain: bounded domain with executable assessment (e.g. program-repair or small synthesis tasks with an exact checker over a declared finite specification)
population.episode: one task plus a prior-work history with varied outcomes
population.holdout: hold out task STRUCTURES / generation regimes, not merely renamed identifiers; include transferable-structure cases AND structure-absent cases where mapping should not help
population.independence_unit: task/family is the higher-level unit; stochastic reruns of one task are averaged/modeled within-task and are NOT counted as independent episodes

budget_accounting.human_intervention: equalized across arms, prohibited during evaluation, or explicitly counted and described as part of the method
budget_accounting.amortization: cold-start and amortized costs reported separately under a declared deployment scenario; shared preprocessing not treated as free for GoW

outcome_dispositions.primary_Y0_means: no verified objective achieved within budget (NOT 'mathematically false' or 'impossible')
outcome_dispositions.denominator_rule: secondary dispositions are never silently dropped from the denominator
outcome_dispositions.verifier_scope: the endpoint measures verified achievement UNDER THE DECLARED EVALUATOR, not an omniscient success rate

adaptive_loop_test.requirement: each episode preserves the sequence: history -> chosen representation + shape hypothesis -> predicted consequence of a selected intervention -> actual domain candidate -> checked result -> updated next action
separates: better_adaptation (feedback yields better SUBSEQUENT attempts than comparator)
adaptive_loop_test.note: only better_adaptation directly substantiates the recursive-cartography thesis

attribution_checks: action_relevance: changing/removing the inferred shape changes the next attempted work
prospective_enrichment: shape-guided proposals succeed more on outcomes NOT used to choose the shape
preservation: gain is not obtained by changing the goal or dropping hard cases
net_efficiency: gain survives charging map + projection cost
adaptive_value: revised maps improve LATER decisions, not merely fit earlier failures
mechanism_measurement: estimate r, rho, and cost-of-using-A directly; compare observed advantage to the paper's Proposition 9.2 prediction

analysis_discipline.fixed_sample: sample size fixed before confirmatory runs; fixed-n Hoeffding bound assumes n was NOT chosen by repeated inspection
analysis_discipline.sequential_option: if continuous monitoring is used, a prespecified confidence sequence / anytime-valid method replaces the fixed-n bound
analysis_discipline.selection_vs_confirmation: development runs used for selection; FRESH confirmatory episodes used for the claim
analysis_discipline.multiple_comparison: comparing multiple baselines requires an explicit multiple-comparison plan or simultaneous bounds

planning_power_calculations.note: stipulated-effect planning only; not forecasts of GoW performance; test superiority over zero, not the 5-point margin

explicitly_not_claimed: that model-endorsement-rate differences equal a verified-search advantage
that the existing pilots (pilot-003, pilot-004) can be retrofitted into these paired tables
any result prior to execution of this design
